name: Bristol Knit Club
description: Love to knit or crochet and want to meet some like-minded people? Come and join us at knit club! A friendly and easygoing group who meet twice a month at Watershed Bar to knit, crochet, and chat.
details: All abilities are welcome, but we bring our own projects to work on, so we recommend knowing the basics of knitting or crochet before coming along. It's completely free to join - we just encourage everyone to support the bar by grabbing a drink or two! Come along to meet new people, swap tips, share projects, and get inspired.

cost.details: Free to attend - please support the bar by buying a drink.
